description: bead-rs release binary built with --features attempt-resolution at HEAD, pinned byte-exact from the build bead's staging
git_commit_message: docs(attempts-binary): add comprehensive build process and verification documentation
notes: The attempt-resolution cargo feature is an empty marker feature: no #[cfg(feature)] gates exist in src/, src/service/attempt.rs compiles unconditionally, and `bead capabilities` advertises attempt_outcome regardless of the flag. A binary built with and without the flag is functionally identical.

The '-dirty' marker in the version string comes from tracked .beads/* checkpoint files modified by the bead CLI's post-claim auto-flush; compiled tracked source (src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs) is exactly HEAD (verified via `git status --porcelain` on those paths).

sha256 is NOT reproducible across rebuilds: build.rs re-embeds BEAD_BUILD_TIMESTAMP whenever .git/index changes, so two rebuilds of identical source hash differently. Pin the staged binary bytes; do not rebuild and expect this hash.
